title: Core Routine Poster System
description: Four reference-dependent images define a classroom routine and rules system across daily overview, handwashing, lining up, and reading-corner expectations.
creative_direction: Image 01 sets the icon language, poster modules, color coding, and blank headline logic. Images 02-04 preserve the same classroom-management system while changing the routine focus.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-routine-board first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-handwashing-sequence-board, 03-line-up-transition-board, 04-reading-corner-board. Queue may run those images concurrently after 01-reference-routine-board is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
